title: A small program with a wide horizon.
intro: Athenae Initiative's events are designed to create a space in which people of all fields can critically engage with the ideas, texts, and questions that shape human experience.
body:
## Public conversations

Evenings with guests and neighbours around one timely question.

## Reading circles

Low-pressure gatherings for sharing a text, a perspective, and a meal.

## Workshops

Hands-on sessions for learning how to investigate, create, and participate.
